columns.comment: Peer group used for ratio benchmarking (PG-nnn); join to gold.dim_peer_group.
columns.name: peer_group_id

columns.comment: Peer group label = industry sector - subsector (e.g. Materials - Mining).
columns.name: peer_group_name

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials); see gold.dim_industry.
columns.name: industry_sector

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors); see gold.dim_industry.
columns.name: industry_subsector

columns.comment: Benchmarked ratio (same names as fact_financial_ratio_annual.ratio_name, e.g. Net Debt/EBITDA, ICR, DSO).
columns.name: ratio_name

columns.comment: Ratio family: Leverage, Coverage, Liquidity, Profitability, Working Capital, Cash Flow or Growth.
columns.name: ratio_category

columns.comment: Unit: x (multiple), fraction (0.15 = 15%), days or usd.
columns.name: ratio_unit

columns.comment: True when a higher ratio is better; false for Net Debt/EBITDA, Debt/Equity, DSO, DIO and cash conversion cycle.
columns.name: higher_is_better

columns.comment: Statement fiscal year of the benchmark (2023-2025).
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.comment: 31 March closing the Japanese fiscal year of the benchmark (FY2025 -> 2026-03-31); calendar key only.
columns.name: fiscal_year_end_date

columns.comment: 25th percentile of the ratio across the peer sample (value-based, in ratio_unit).
columns.name: peer_p25

columns.comment: Median (P50) of the ratio across the peer sample.
columns.name: peer_median

columns.comment: 75th percentile of the ratio across the peer sample (value-based).
columns.name: peer_p75

columns.comment: Inter-quartile range P75 - P25 in ratio_unit.
columns.name: peer_iqr

columns.comment: Clients in the peer sample (as published with the benchmark).
columns.name: peer_n_clients

columns.comment: Our client ratio values in the peer group and fiscal year (fact_financial_ratio_annual rows with a value).
columns.name: n_client_values

columns.comment: Of those, values in the bottom quartile of performance (direction-aware worse_than_p25).
columns.name: n_clients_worse_than_p25

comment: Peer benchmarks for financial ratios (brief 5.3): one row per peer group (industry subsector) x ratio x fiscal year (FY2023-FY2025) with the peer 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile, the sample size, the ratio direction and how many of our clients are in the bottom quartile of performance (direction-aware). Benchmarks are point values (never sum P25 / median / P75 across rows). Grain: one row per peer group x ratio x fiscal year.
